data.name: Zone Stalkers
data.detailed_description:
In the Drugograd Anomalous Zone, death is cheap… losing your gear doesn’t have to be.

You are a Stalker. Prep in the Hub, dive a hand-crafted raid, and extract with artifacts — or die trying. Mutants hunt. Anomalies lie. Other stalkers want what you’re carrying.

The twist: Stalker Insurance.

Pay before the raid (cheaper) or after you die (a lot more). Either way, the Zone's filing a claim. Less gear fear. More aggressive, high-stakes runs.

Pay to protect your gear. Die anyway. Come back stronger.

Key Features

- Hub → Raid → Extract — Prep in the Hub, deploy into the Zone, extract or die, then return to gear up again.

- Stalker Insurance — Die covered, or pay dear to get the kit back. Rebuild from the Hub.

- Extract with your haul — Make it out and keep what you carried.

- Hub sanctuary — Traders, stash, campfire, and deploy pads in a safe hangout before the next dive.

- Solo & multiplayer paths — Green pad for solo raids; multiplayer lobby path toward shared Kolkhoz runs when online play is available.

- Anomalies, mutants, artifacts — Read the shimmer, throw a bolt, fight what the Zone throws at you.

data.short_description: Pay to protect your gear and save your life. Die anyway. Come back stronger. First-person PvPvE extraction in a haunted Exclusion Zone. Take Stalker Insurance before the raid — or pay a lot more after you die. Artifacts, mutants, anomalies, rival stalkers. Either way, the Zone's filing a claim.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 80 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

content_descriptors.notes: This is a first-person shooter with gun combat. Players fight mutants and rival stalkers, and characters can be killed.
